title: Cute, But....
text: Cute, But..... I love decorating for fall! This pair of lanterns is cute, but....... It was packed inside well, but it wasn't enough to survive the transport. The sides of the lantern are glass. They're not welded inside. Instead, it's like the glass in a picture frame. So when I was setting these up, both lanterns had at least one glass panel that I had to reinsert. The back panel on the smaller lantern was broken in one of the corners. There was a piece about the size of a lemon broken off. There was a large piece of glass as well as lots of small pieces all over the inside of the box. Luckily, this was the back panel, so it's not very noticeable. The decor pieces come inside a bag and you have to set it up your self. I'm not very good with that, so I did the best I could. I thought that there would be a flameless battery operated candle as shown in the pictures, but there's not. I kind of wish they had included a picture of what it "could" look like when you're done. Instead, I had to keep looking up the product description. I didn't use all of the decorations, they did provide a lot. I am happy with the way it looks. I am very concerned about storing it after the season so it doesn't break any further.
